title: Keyturn Vehicle Listing: Recording a Move between Value Classes
content:
Where the marketplace has settled which value class a vehicle belongs in, the listing is moved into that class and the money figure that governs the listing is put onto the record at the same time. One call rewrites the class the listing sits in and the vehicle value carried on it; the listing keeps its standing, its price and its condition history untouched. Afterwards the host sees the vehicle showing the new class and the new governing value wherever the listing is displayed.

### Making the entry

The desk unlocks the agent-side tool `reassign_value_class_4bb6b10c` and calls it. One call moves one listing.

### Parameters

- `vehicle_id` — the listing reference number of the vehicle being moved, read from the vehicle listing lookup before the call.
- `value_class_name` — the value class the listing is moved into, exactly one of: `Keyturn Economy Class Listing`, the entry class for the lowest value band; `Keyturn Standard Class Listing`, the class for mid value band vehicles; `Keyturn Premium Class Listing`, the class for the premium value band; `Keyturn Luxury Class Listing`, the class for high value passenger vehicles; `Keyturn Exotic Class Listing`, the class for the highest value vehicles; `Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing`, the class for commercially plated vans.
- `governing_value_amount` — the vehicle value that governs the listing from now on, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half away from zero at the point it is written; an amount of 0.00 means no value governs the listing.

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the listing that was moved, the value class it now sits in and the governing value written onto it to 2 decimal places. A sentence naming the listing is what indicates the class and the value now stand on the record; a report that the listing could not be found means nothing was written.
